_comment_engines: Template name -> provisioning scripts + port. Every template that should be usable as a DBaaS engine MUST be listed here (the deployed config.json on the management server -- not only this example), or listDbaasEngines never returns it, the wizard cannot pick it and createDatabase refuses it. Add a new engine here and drop its scripts into every dbaas-* image's /opt/dbaas/ (see TEMPLATES.md) -- never hardcode this mapping in the Java source. 'script' is invoked by firstboot.sh INSIDE the instance, reading the request from the config drive; 'reset_script' is not called by anything yet (resetting a database password needs the in-VM agent, PLAN.md Phase D) but is kept here so that agent can reuse it without a config change. Templates must also carry the dbaas.configdrive=true template detail (see requireConfigDriveTemplate in DbaasManagerImpl).
